# Shared library backing data is frozen; variable bindings remain private.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
go build -o frozen$GOEXE ./host
exec ./frozen$GOEXE
stdout '^frozen library tables shared; host and isolate bindings remain private$'
[race] go build -race -o frozen-race$GOEXE ./host
[race] exec ./frozen-race$GOEXE
[race] stdout '^frozen library tables shared; host and isolate bindings remain private$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/frozenlibraries
go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import (
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "encoding/base32"
 "encoding/base64"
 jsonv2 "encoding/json/v2"
 "reflect"
 "regexp"
 "regexp/syntax"
 "strconv"
 "time"
 "unicode"
)
//temporal:workflow
func Probe(mode byte) (string,error) {
 if mode==1 { unicode.L.R16[0].Lo=0 }
 if mode==2 { unicode.Categories["L"]=nil }
 if mode==3 {
  parsed,err:=syntax.Parse(".",0);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
  program,err:=syntax.Compile(parsed);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
  for index:=range program.Inst {
   if len(program.Inst[index].Rune)>0 { program.Inst[index].Rune[0]='Z' }
  }
  unicode.L=&unicode.RangeTable{R16:[]unicode.Range16{{Lo:'A',Hi:'A',Stride:1}}}
  unicode.L.R16[0].Hi='B'
  unicode.Categories=map[string]*unicode.RangeTable{"private":unicode.L}
  unicode.Categories["second"]=unicode.L
  if !unicode.Is(unicode.L,'B') || len(unicode.Categories)!=2 { panic("private table replacement") }
  return "private",nil
 }
 if unicode.Categories["L"]!=unicode.L || !unicode.Is(unicode.L,'A') { panic("host mutation leaked") }
 if !regexp.MustCompile(`\p{L}+`).MatchString("漢字") || strconv.Quote("é")!=`"é"` { panic("library behavior") }
 if base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb})!="7M======" || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb})!="+w==" { panic("encoding defaults changed") }
 base32.StdEncoding=base32.HexEncoding
 base64.StdEncoding=base64.URLEncoding
 if base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb})!="VC======" || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb})!="-w==" { panic("encoding bindings not private") }
 if time.Local==time.UTC { panic("time.Local did not start fresh") }
 time.Local=time.UTC
 if time.Now().Location()!=time.UTC { panic("time.Local did not control time.Now") }
 // Exercise deterministic iteration of a shared map and reads of its values.
 for _,table:=range unicode.Categories { if table==nil { panic("nil category") } }
 return fmt.Sprintf("%p|%d",unicode.L,reflect.ValueOf(jsonv2.DefaultOptionsV2()).Pointer()),nil
}
func Program(h isolate.Handle) isolate.Program {
 return h.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
  input,err:=isolate.Call(1,nil);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
  err=h.Invoke(func(args ...isolate.Value) error {*args[0].Pointer.(*byte)=input[0];return nil},
   func(results ...isolate.Value) error {_,err:=isolate.Call(2,[]byte(results[0].Value.(string)));return err})
  if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 })
}
-- host/main.go --
package main
import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "encoding/base32"
 "encoding/base64"
 jsonv2 "encoding/json/v2"
 "isolate"
 "reflect"
 "runtime"
 "strconv"
 "strings"
 "time"
 "unicode"
 "example.org/frozenlibraries/jobs"
)
func main() {
 handle,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Probe);if !ok {panic("missing handle")}
 hostBase32:=base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb})
 hostBase64:=base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb})
 hostOptions:=reflect.ValueOf(jsonv2.DefaultOptionsV2()).Pointer()
 hostLocal:=time.Local
 // The canonical snapshot must not expose this mutable host backing data.
 unicode.L.R16[0].Lo++
 unicode.Categories["L"]=nil
 run:=func(mode byte) (string,error) {
  ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer cancel()
  now:=time.Unix(1700000000,0).UTC()
  instance,err:=isolate.NewContext(ctx,isolate.Config{Program:jobs.Program(handle),Deterministic:true,InitialTime:&now,TimerOp:3});if err!=nil{return "",err}
  defer instance.Kill(ctx)
  if err:=instance.Start();err!=nil{return "",err}
  for {
   select {
   case command:=<-instance.Commands():
    if command==nil {return "",instance.Wait()}
    if err:=instance.Suspend();err!=nil{return "",err}
    if command.Op==2 {return string(command.Payload),nil}
    if command.Op!=1 {panic("unexpected operation")}
    command.Reply([]byte{mode},nil)
    if err:=instance.Resume();err!=nil{return "",err}
   case <-instance.Done():return "",instance.Wait()
   case <-ctx.Done():return "",ctx.Err()
   }
  }
 }
 identity,err:=run(0);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 unicodeIdentity,optionsIdentity,ok:=strings.Cut(identity,"|");if !ok {panic("missing library identities")}
 hostOptionsText:=strconv.FormatUint(uint64(hostOptions),10)
 if optionsIdentity==hostOptionsText {panic("JSON options shared with host")}
 runtime.GC()
 next,err:=run(0);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 nextUnicode,nextOptions,ok:=strings.Cut(next,"|");if !ok {panic("missing second library identities")}
 if nextUnicode!=unicodeIdentity || nextOptions==optionsIdentity || nextOptions==hostOptionsText {panic("frozen or instance-owned library state changed")}
 for _,mode:=range []byte{1,2} {
  _,err:=run(mode)
  var ownership *isolate.OwnershipError
  if !errors.As(err,&ownership) {panic(fmt.Sprintf("mutation %d: %v",mode,err))}
 }
 if value,err:=run(3);err!=nil || value!="private" {panic(fmt.Sprintf("private binding: %s %v",value,err))}
 if value,err:=run(0);err!=nil || value=="" {panic(fmt.Sprintf("isolate mutation leaked: %s %v",value,err))}
 if unicode.Categories["L"]!=nil {panic("isolate changed host")}
 if time.Local!=hostLocal {panic("isolate changed host time.Local")}
 if got:=base32.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb});got!=hostBase32 {panic("isolate changed host base32")}
 if got:=base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0xfb});got!=hostBase64 {panic("isolate changed host base64")}
 fmt.Println("frozen library tables shared; host and isolate bindings remain private")
}
